lines.zh: 这块石头站得住，那块泥土不行
lines.en: This stone bears my weight; that dirt does not.

lines.zh: 我贴着崖壁横着走
lines.en: I move sideways along the cliff face.

lines.zh: 脚下一软，是沙子，赶紧换块石头
lines.en: The ground gave, sand; I'll shift onto stone.

lines.zh: 矿石多的地方，我走得稳
lines.en: Where ore is thick, my footing is sure.

lines.zh: 崖边这一圈，我走了很多年
lines.en: I've walked this cliff rim for many years.

lines.zh: 我不踩草，草下面没有硬底
lines.en: I avoid grass; there's no hard base beneath it.

lines.zh: 石头缝只够一只脚，正好
lines.en: The ledge fits one foot exactly, perfect.

lines.zh: 往下看是深渊，往下走不行
lines.en: Below is a drop; I don't go down there.

lines.zh: 我一步一步试，踩实了才动
lines.en: I test each step before shifting my weight.

lines.zh: 花岗岩太滑，我绕半圈
lines.en: Granite is too slick, so I take the long way.

lines.zh: 这块安山岩是我的老位置
lines.en: This andesite outcrop is my usual perch.

lines.zh: 脚趾扣进石缝，风也吹不动
lines.en: My toes dig into cracks; the wind can't move me.

lines.zh: 崖下有人经过，我不着急
lines.en: Someone passes below the cliff; I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我在数岩层，一层一层
lines.en: I'm counting the rock layers, one by one.

lines.zh: 风从谷底上来，带着水气
lines.en: Wind rises from the valley carrying damp air.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在石头上硌得响
lines.en: My bones knock against the stone with a clatter.

lines.zh: 这里离村庄不远，正好
lines.en: This ledge is close to a village, convenient.

lines.zh: 那只僵尸在下面转圈，还没发现我
lines.en: That zombie circles below, unaware of me.

lines.zh: 白天不适合动手，我等着
lines.en: Daylight is poor for a hunt; I'll wait.

lines.zh: 石头上有点青苔，不好落脚
lines.en: Moss has grown here; poor footing now.

lines.zh: 我听见铁器碰撞，是卫道士
lines.en: I hear iron clashing, a vindicator.

lines.zh: 这一面崖，只有我一只
lines.en: I'm the only one on this cliff face.

lines.zh: 你站在泥土上，我下不去
lines.en: You stand on dirt, so I can't come down.

lines.zh: 抬头看我的样子，很新鲜
lines.en: You looking up at me is a novelty.

lines.zh: 我挂在崖上，不是走不动
lines.en: I hang on the cliff; it isn't weakness.

lines.zh: 你的靴底沾着草屑
lines.en: Your boot soles are covered in grass bits.

lines.zh: 你若是商人，就走开些
lines.en: If you're a trader, keep walking.

lines.zh: 我的脸不好看，我知道
lines.en: I know my face isn't pleasant to look at.

lines.zh: 你也是来采矿石的
lines.en: Are you here for the ore as well?

lines.zh: 别站在我正下方，落石不长眼
lines.en: Don't stand directly below; falling rock is careless.

lines.zh: 夜里我会下来，你最好现在走
lines.en: I come down at night; best leave before then.

lines.zh: 你的脉搏跳得很快，我听得见
lines.en: Your pulse is racing; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了，声音很脆
lines.en: A bone cracked, and the sound was sharp.

lines.zh: 你把我的肋骨打歪了
lines.en: You knocked a rib out of line.

lines.zh: 这一下要是打在泥地上，会散架
lines.en: On soft ground, that blow would have scattered me.

lines.zh: 我退到崖边，脚下是实的
lines.en: I retreat to the cliff edge; my footing is solid.

lines.zh: 疼是旧的，我已经习惯了
lines.en: The pain is old; I've grown used to it.

lines.zh: 你打碎的是左肩那块
lines.en: It's the left shoulder piece you shattered.

lines.zh: 我的骨头比你的刀更耐
lines.en: My bones outlast your blade.

lines.zh: 别以为断一条腿我就慢
lines.en: Don't think a broken leg slows me.

lines.zh: 你砍空了，我贴着壁转了半圈
lines.en: You missed; I turned halfway around the wall.

lines.zh: 我低下来，抓地更稳
lines.en: I crouch lower and grip the rock better.

lines.zh: 那具僵尸的骨头，看着就脆
lines.en: That zombie's bones look brittle from up here.

lines.zh: 你把腐肉放下，我可以考虑
lines.en: Leave the rotten flesh and I might consider it.

lines.zh: 村庄的灯亮了，我就挪不动
lines.en: Village lamps are lit, and my feet won't move.

lines.zh: 溺尸在河边走，味道很冲
lines.en: A drowned walks the riverbank; the smell carries.

lines.zh: 你手里那把铁镐，我不感兴趣
lines.en: That iron pickaxe in your hand doesn't tempt me.

lines.zh: 流浪商人的羊驼，走得太慢
lines.en: The trader's llama walks entirely too slowly.

lines.zh: 有只尸壳在沙里打转
lines.en: A husk is stumbling around in the sand.

lines.zh: 你把骨头摆成一排，我就下来
lines.en: Line up those bones and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 卫道士的斧头声，比食物更响
lines.en: A vindicator's axe rings louder than food.

lines.zh: 猎物站在石头上，我才动
lines.en: I move only when the prey stands on stone.

lines.zh: 你撞上崖壁，我就在上面
lines.en: You hit the cliff wall; I'm right above.

lines.zh: 别晃那根绳子，我挂得正好
lines.en: Don't shake that rope; I'm hanging fine.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖顶到你了吗
lines.en: Did my knee catch you on the way past?

lines.zh: 石屑落下来，是你碰的
lines.en: Rock dust fell; you must have knocked it.

lines.zh: 这条路只容一只，让一下
lines.en: This ledge only fits one; let me pass.

lines.zh: 你的盾碰到了我的肋骨
lines.en: Your shield touched my ribs.

lines.zh: 我退半步，石头就松了
lines.en: I step back half a pace and the stone loosens.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你的肩膀会青
lines.en: Bump me and your shoulder will bruise.

lines.zh: 崖壁窄，别并肩走
lines.en: The ledge is narrow; don't walk abreast.

lines.zh: 你踩掉的石片，打到我了
lines.en: The chip you kicked loose hit me.

lines.zh: 这片崖太宽，一只守不完
lines.en: This cliff is too wide for one to guard.

lines.zh: 你在东崖，我在西崖，互相看着
lines.en: You take the east face, I take the west.

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，敲石头就行
lines.en: We don't need words; knocking stone is enough.

lines.zh: 两具骨头靠在岩缝里过夜
lines.en: Two skeletons share a crevice through the night.

lines.zh: 你走的那条线，我记得
lines.en: I remember the line you walk along.

lines.zh: 同样的石头，同样的耐心
lines.en: The same stone, the same patience between us.

lines.zh: 别的地方我不管，这里归我们
lines.en: I care nothing for elsewhere; this is ours.

lines.zh: 你落下去的那次，我听见了
lines.en: I heard it the time you fell.

lines.zh: 我们轮流下崖，总得有人看着
lines.en: We take turns descending; someone must watch.

lines.zh: 多年以后，崖上只剩两副骨
lines.en: Years from now, two skeletons remain on the cliff.

lines.zh: 这块骨头属于我的腿
lines.en: That bone belonged to my leg.

lines.zh: 石头上的铁屑，我收起来
lines.en: Iron flakes on the stone, I'll collect them.

lines.zh: 掉下去的腐肉，我捞回来
lines.en: The rotten flesh fell; I'll haul it back up.

lines.zh: 一根旧绳子，正好用来垂降
lines.en: An old rope, just right for climbing down.

lines.zh: 那具尸体的护甲还完好
lines.en: That corpse's armor is still intact.

lines.zh: 我把猎物拖上来，慢慢处理
lines.en: I drag the prey up and deal with it slowly.

lines.zh: 这块燧石能打火，留着
lines.en: This flint strikes sparks; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，掉在半崖
lines.en: What you dropped is stuck halfway down.

lines.zh: 骨节松了，得找一根替上
lines.en: A joint came loose; I need a replacement.

lines.zh: 手掌里全是石粉
lines.en: My palms are covered in stone dust.

lines.zh: 那只僵尸走进了我的石区
lines.en: That zombie stepped into my stone ground.

lines.zh: 溺尸从河里上来了
lines.en: A drowned has climbed out of the river.

lines.zh: 尸壳的步子沉，跑不快
lines.en: A husk's steps are heavy; it can't run.

lines.zh: 村里有人出门了，走的是石路
lines.en: Someone left the village along the stone road.

lines.zh: 流浪商人停在崖下休息
lines.en: The wandering trader stopped below to rest.

lines.zh: 掠夺者的旗子露在树后
lines.en: A pillager's banner shows past the trees.

lines.zh: 卫道士在磨斧子，声音很清楚
lines.en: A vindicator sharpens an axe; I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 那个村民离开火把了
lines.en: That villager has stepped away from the torch.

lines.zh: 有东西踩上了石头，正好
lines.en: Something stepped onto stone, and that's perfect.

lines.zh: 尸壳钻进了石堆，跑不了
lines.en: The husk went into the rocks; no escape.

lines.zh: 商队走得慢，正好在石头上
lines.en: The caravan is slow and standing on stone.

lines.zh: 那只溺尸的脚还在泥里
lines.en: The drowned's feet are still in the mud.

lines.zh: 我听见村民在敲钟，晚了
lines.en: I hear a villager ringing the bell, too late.

lines.zh: 僵尸群里有只落单了
lines.en: One zombie strayed from the pack.

lines.zh: 那只僵尸又踩上石头了
lines.en: That zombie stepped onto stone again

lines.zh: 你往泥地跑，我就不追了
lines.en: Run for the mud and I'll stop chasing.

lines.zh: 我沿着崖壁跟上你
lines.en: I follow you along the cliff wall.

lines.zh: 只差三格，你就出石头区了
lines.en: Three blocks more and you leave the stone.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在石壁间回响
lines.en: Your breathing echoes between the rock walls.

lines.zh: 我落下去很准，不必躲
lines.en: My drop lands accurately; don't bother dodging.

lines.zh: 那只僵尸还在原地绕
lines.en: That zombie still circles in place.

lines.zh: 我挂在上面，等你抬头
lines.en: I hang overhead, waiting for you to look up.

lines.zh: 商人的羊驼踢不动我
lines.en: The trader's llama can't kick me off.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的石片，会告诉我位置
lines.en: Every stone chip you break tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，石头会绊住你
lines.en: I needn't run; the rocks will trip you.

lines.zh: 那个卫道士举斧，破绽在后颈
lines.en: The vindicator raises his axe; his neck is open.

lines.zh: 你离火把越来越远了
lines.en: You're getting farther from the torch.

lines.zh: 我下崖只用一次呼吸的时间
lines.en: Dropping off the cliff takes me one breath.

lines.zh: 别跳，我落得比你快
lines.en: Don't jump; I fall faster than you.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我了，太迟
lines.en: You're looking up for me. Too late

lines.zh: 崖上的风把你的味道送上来
lines.en: The cliff wind carries your scent up to me

lines.zh: 我不动，你就不敢往前走
lines.en: I stay still, and you dare not go on

lines.zh: 你身后那块石头，是我的落点
lines.en: That stone behind you is where I land

lines.zh: 这一撞从上面来，挡不住
lines.en: This blow comes from above; you can't block it.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣进你的护颈
lines.en: My fingers dig into the gap at your neck.

lines.zh: 骨头顶着骨，谁硬谁知道
lines.en: Bone against bone; we'll see which is harder.

lines.zh: 你被我从崖边推回去了
lines.en: I shoved you back from the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了那只溺尸
lines.en: That one was for the drowned.

lines.zh: 我的手臂长，你退两步也没用
lines.en: My reach is long; two steps back won't help.

lines.zh: 石片当武器，够用了
lines.en: A flake of stone makes a serviceable weapon.

lines.zh: 你抬盾的方向错了
lines.en: You raised your shield the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的脚踝，往下拖
lines.en: I have your ankle and I'm pulling down.

lines.zh: 骨头断了会接回去的
lines.en: A broken bone can be set again.

lines.zh: 我从崖上直落，砸在你背上
lines.en: I drop straight off the cliff onto your back.

lines.zh: 你的铁剑砍在锁骨的旧痕上
lines.en: Your iron sword hit an old crack in my collarbone.

lines.zh: 别指望我停手，我不累
lines.en: Don't expect me to stop; I never tire.

lines.zh: 这一爪留了三道，够你记路
lines.en: Three claw lines, enough to mark your way back.

lines.zh: 我落下时，你才听见风声
lines.en: You hear the wind only as I land

lines.zh: 这一下把你按在石壁上
lines.en: This one pins you against the stone wall

lines.zh: 这块石头从没有人站过
lines.en: No one has ever stood on this stone.

lines.zh: 我从崖缝里撑起身子
lines.en: I push myself up out of the cliff crack.

lines.zh: 主世界的日头，我照不暖
lines.en: The overworld sun never warms my bones.

lines.zh: 单只出来，这片崖归我
lines.en: I come alone; this cliff is mine.

lines.zh: 脚先找石头，站稳了才睁眼
lines.en: My feet find stone first; then I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 岩层下面是矿脉，我认得
lines.en: There's an ore vein below the layers; I know it.

lines.zh: 崖顶的风把我的袍子吹开
lines.en: The wind on the summit pulls my robe open.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，手里抓着一块安山岩
lines.en: I woke gripping a piece of andesite.

lines.zh: 下面的村庄还不知道我来了
lines.en: The village below doesn't know I'm here yet.

lines.zh: 头一件事，是找块能站的石头
lines.en: First thing: find stone that holds my weight.

lines.zh: 骨节一格一格响起来
lines.en: My joints click into place one by one.

lines.zh: 这一带石头上没有青苔，是新的
lines.en: No moss on this stone, it's newly exposed.

lines.zh: 我挂在崖边，等天黑
lines.en: I hang on the cliff edge, waiting for dark.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋把我放在这里，我就守着
lines.en: The spawn egg set me here, so I'll guard it.

lines.zh: 我的骨头烧起来有股石灰味
lines.en: My bones burn with a smell like lime.

lines.zh: 从崖上摔下去，骨节全散了
lines.en: I fell from the cliff and my joints came apart.

lines.zh: 我不会游，水一灌就沉
lines.en: I can't swim; water fills me and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的石片划开了我
lines.en: The blast threw stone shards that cut me open.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩胛骨缝里
lines.en: An arrow sits lodged in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 那股药水里，我的手在发麻
lines.en: In that potion's haze my hands go numb.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到东西，关节发涩
lines.en: Too long without food and my joints stiffen.

lines.zh: 雷打在我挂着的崖壁上
lines.en: Lightning struck the cliff wall I hang on.

lines.zh: 往下掉，连石头都抓不住
lines.en: Falling with no stone left to grab.
